messages:
maya (billing): quick sync from the postmortem thread — delayed token attribution caused some invoices to understate usage. need clear ownership: detection, ledger backfill, invoice reissue policy, and customer comms escalation.
arjun (finance): i'm fine owning the ledger backfill + invoice reissues. can someone produce a vetted list of affected invoice IDs + net token delta? i'll need to collate for AR and tax.
liam (eng-infra): i'll take detection + alerting hook. plan: a streaming metric 'ingest_ack_delay_ms' and a rule -> #metering-alerts + create MET-4723. ETA: tomorrow morning.
jordan (eng-sre): preliminary root cause: consumer's in-flight batch window didn't close on DB deadlock -> delayed commit attribution. adding commit-timeout and idempotent replay. PR in 36h, rollout 3 calendar days(canary first).
sophia (customer-success): i'll assemble comms templates: 1) automated credit notice, 2) reissue notice for corrected invoice. will coordinate subject lines with legal if wording sensitive.
nina (legal): flag: for customers under certain contracts we must include language about retrospective invoices. loop me in on the reissue templates.
maya (billing): attaching quick extract (prelim) for finance to triage:
```csv
invoice_id,customer_id,period_start,period_end,token_delta
inv_20260323_001,cust_301,2026-03-23T00:00Z,2026-03-23T01:00Z, -810
inv_20260323_002,cust_078,2026-03-23T00:20Z,2026-03-23T00:45Z, -210
```
arjun (finance): thanks. policy question: do we reissue invoices or apply credit notes? prefer credit notes for smaller deltas to avoid tax complications unless delta > $1000. propose threshold.
nina (legal): agree on credit notes for most cases. reissue only if statutory requirement or customer contract demands it. set reissue threshold $1k+ and flag per-region tax rules.
liam (eng-infra): detection rule I'll emit: "ingest_ack_delay_ms > 60000 AND estimated_token_delta < -100". also will attach sampling info (trace id + shard) to the ticket.
arjun (finance): timeline: once final list produced by detection, i'll prepare CSV in AR format (invoice_id,customer_id,token_delta,usd_amount,requires_reissue). target: complete credits for <$1k deltas in 2 business days; reissue flow for >$1k in 5 business days.
sophia (customer-success): I'll queue proactive outreach for enterprise accounts > $10k MRR — want to call them before we reissue. will escalate via AE.
jordan (eng-sre): extra mitigations: add a nightly health job that computes per-shard token drift and surfaces recurring offenders. ETA 6d.
maya (billing): action items recap: liam -> detection + MET-4723 (tomorrow AM); jordan -> PR for commit timeout & idempotency (PR 36h, rollout 3d); arjun -> credit vs reissue runbook + AR CSV (start after detection, credits < $1k in 2bd, reissue > $1k in 5bd); sophia -> enterprise outreach plan (ASAP); nina -> review legal wording for reissue template (24h).
billing-bot: Ticket MET-4723 created: "ingest_ack_delay -> underreported tokens" assigned to eng-infra.
arjun (finance): one more note: include a column 'requires_tax_review' for APAC customers; i'll route those separately.
maya (billing): will add that. i'll update the postmortem follow-up doc and ping for a 48h review. thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
